summary: Wrote tests/specs/EE-10.md with 6 test case specifications (TC-EE-10-01 through TC-EE-10-06) covering all EE-10 acceptance criteria. Wrote tests/integration/instance_error_test.zig with 6 integration tests exercising the setInstanceError and completeTask paths against a real PostgreSQL database. Fixed the INSERT to use the CTE-based sequence pattern matching all other event inserts, with the correct columns including idempotency_key. zig build, zig build test, and zig build test-integration all exit 0.

issues_found.description: src/engine/instance.zig setInstanceError() was inserting into 'event_store' (non-existent table) instead of 'events'. The design doc engine.md uses 'event_store' as the table name throughout, but migrations/001_event_store.sql creates the actual table as 'events'. All other event INSERTs in instance.zig correctly use 'events'. Fixed: replaced the INSERT with the CTE-based sequence pattern matching cancelInstance and completeTask, targeting the 'events' table with correct columns (sequence_number, idempotency_key). A random idempotency UUID is generated per insert.
